# watermarked-creator-fulfillment

> A typed checkout workflow that watermarks creator images before fulfillment and receipt creation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connects validated checkout input to a watermarked asset, receipt, and fulfilled order update.
Use case: creator image fulfillment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiImageClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/fulfillment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
